title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One: card flavor text

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor of the Fair Basilica on New Phyrexia, whose servants are sleepless and who knew the planeswalker strike team was coming.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker who is greeted by a compleated friend, reunites with Koth, and consigns a blast and herself to the nothingness in between.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Planeswalker and resistance member who reunites with Elspeth and hopes to exploit the war between Norn and Urabrask.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: Resistance member who helped design a safehouse against oil infection.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Phyrexian speaker who urges drowning and hearing only harmony.

entities.name: Ajani

entities.name: Prahan
entities.description: Mirran rebel awaiting skyhunter reinforcements.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who watched an illusion of the Sylex vanish from her hands.

entities.name: Jace

entities.name: Sylex

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: Resistance spymaster.

entities.name: Sarnvax

entities.name: Uulbrek

events.summary: New Phyrexia's planar defenses scatter the planeswalker strike team on arrival; Elesh Norn knew they were coming.
events.quote: Elesh Norn knew they were coming.
"I was about to say the same, my friend," Elspeth replied.

events.summary: Elspeth consigns a blast that would level New Phyrexia and a dozen worlds, and herself, to the nothingness in between.
events.quote: Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.

events.summary: Kaya watches an illusion vanish: Jace holds the real Sylex and activates it before phyresis claims his mind.
events.quote: Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.

events.summary: Jace believes he can save Vraska, but she betrays him for the glory of Phyrexia.
events.quote: "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.

events.summary: Phyresis curdles in Vraska's blood and she knows she will betray even Jace.
events.quote: She knew as soon as it took her, she would betray everything—even Jace.

events.summary: The Invasion Tree breaks through the Blind Eternities and sends Phyrexian perfection across the Multiverse.
events.quote: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.

events.summary: Nahiri tears apart Sheoldred's Coliseum with her last free breath.
events.quote: Nahiri's last free breath became a defiant roar as she tore apart Sheoldred's Coliseum.

events.summary: As the infection spreads, Nahiri's thoughts grow tangled about protecting what she loves from Phyrexia.
events.quote: As the infection spread, Nahiri's thoughts grew tangled.

events.summary: Phyrexian engineers remodel Mirrodin's two layers into nine since conquering it.
events.quote: Since conquering Mirrodin, Phyrexian engineers have worked tirelessly to transform the plane's original two layers into a more fitting array of nine.

events.summary: Darven speaks his last words to Malach.
events.quote: Isn't that right, Malach? ...Malach?" —Darven, Mirran rebel, last words

events.summary: Urabrask's smiths build freely once the Quiet Furnace is closed to other factions.
events.quote: With the Quiet Furnace closed to all other factions, Urabrask's smiths were free to build anything their creativity demanded.

In Jin-Gitaxias's domain, strange and terrible experiments iterate toward perfection, unbound by ethics.
In Elesh Norn's domain, the gospel of unity is the highest law.
In Sheoldred's domain, the Steel Thanes wage a never-ending war in her long shadow.
